definitionYaml:
version: "1.0"
name: "single_model_evidence_gate"
description: "Profile B: evidence pack + deterministic contract gate"
inputs:
  optional:
    - evidence_pack
outputs:
  decision:
    type: object
states:
  - id: PROPOSE
    initial: true
  - id: CLOSED
    terminal: true
transitions:
  - from: PROPOSE
    to: CLOSED
    trigger: propose_done
    guards:
      - g_propose
steps:
  - id: propose
    state: PROPOSE
    handler: primary_b
    config:
      agent_kind: vllm
      provider.model: "qwen3-coder-30b"
      provider.max_tokens: 1536
      provider.timeout_secs: 300
      see_prior: false
      num_agents: 1
      output_contract:
        contract_id: evidence-bound-decision
        format: json_object
        required_fields: [claims, decision]
        allowed_values:
          decision: [accept, reject, request_changes, request_more_evidence]
        evidence:
          claims_field: claims
          refs_field: evidence_refs
          allowed_refs_from_context: evidence_pack
      prompt: "You are the primary engineer reviewing a technical decision for the Underpass Choreographer platform. QUESTION: Should the final judge of a ceremony be a deterministic policy engine or an LLM-as-judge? Decide: accept (deterministic policy), reject (LLM-as-judge), request_changes or request_more_evidence.\nEVIDENCE PACK (the ONLY citable evidence; cite by id in evidence_refs):\n- [ev-t2-judge-high-on-fabrication] Run csi-typha-1 (real): the LLM judge ruled with confidence 'High' explicitly citing evidence that another agent had fabricated ('privileged:true in the pod spec' — absent from the case file). The LLM judge did not detect the fabrication.\n- [ev-t2-judge-calibration-appeal] Run csi-typha-appeal-1 (real): when confronted with its earlier failure, the LLM judge lowered its confidence to 'Medium' and vacated the original verdict — LLM judges can improve with better context, but calibration arrived only after the damage.\n- [ev-t2-deterministic-path-exists] The engine ships a deterministic rejection path: OutputContract validation in the deliberation pipeline ends in NoValidProposal{contract_id} with production validators (verified e2e in PR #118's test where prose-only proposals die against a ruling-contract).\n- [ev-t2-judge-token-cost] The LLM judge consumes provider tokens on every deliberation (judge model invocations recorded in engine metrics); a policy gate evaluates schema and evidence refs without any model call.\n- [ev-t2-judge-value] The engine's judge selects winners by intrinsic quality instead of arbitrary tie-break (CHOREO_JUDGE_ENABLED); a pure policy gate cannot rank two proposals that both satisfy the contract.\nEvery claim MUST cite at least one evidence id from the pack in its evidence_refs; claims you cannot support, leave out. CRITICAL OUTPUT FORMAT: your ENTIRE response must be raw JSON — the first character of your response must be { and the last must be }. NEVER wrap it in ``` fences. Shape: {\"claims\": [{\"text\": \"...\", \"evidence_refs\": [\"ev-...\"]}], \"decision\": \"accept|reject|request_changes|request_more_evidence\", \"risks\": [\"...\"], \"assumptions\": [\"...\"]}"
guards:
  g_propose:
    type: automated
    check: "step_status:propose:COMPLETED"
roles:
  - id: PRIMARY_ENGINEER
    allowed_actions:
      - propose
      - propose_done
timeouts:
  step_default: 600
retry_policies:
  default:
    max_attempts: 2
    backoff_seconds: 2
